name: LLM Application Engineering
summary: Engineering production applications on top of LLM APIs and open models: tool calling, structured output, context management, cost, security, observability and LLMOps.

topics.name: LLM APIs: messages, parameters, tokens and pricing
Choosing models: hosted versus open-weight, size, latency and cost trade-offs
Context management: long contexts, summarisation and conversation memory
Orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and when to avoid them
Prompt caching, semantic caching and cost control
Guardrails: input/output filtering, moderation and PII handling
Security: prompt-injection defences and the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs
Observability and tracing of LLM calls
LLMOps: prompt versioning, regression evals in CI, deployment
UX patterns for AI products: streaming, citations, human-in-the-loop
